reviewNotes:
RetroFold turns iPhone Duo into a 90s handheld console. Closed, the cover display shows the cartridges: swipe and pick one. Unfolded, the inner display shows the game screen above the fold and the controls below; folding pauses the game. On an iPhone without a hinge, the whole console shows on screen: tap a cartridge on the shelf to play (Lunar Hinge uses the A button or the up arrow instead of folding).

Game Pak (new in this version): a cartridge that plays the player's own Game Boy / Game Boy Color files, imported from Files (tap the Game Pak cartridge, then A on "Load a game"). The app includes no games and links to no game sources; it uses the open-source SameBoy core (MIT) and its open-source boot ROMs, as guideline 4.7 allows for retro console emulators. For testing, any homebrew .gb file works.

Free download: eight cartridges are free, and each Pro cartridge can be played free for 3 minutes a day (a timer shows at the top of the screen; when it runs out, the store opens). Open Store in the toolbar, or tap a locked (dusty) cartridge, to see RetroFold Pro (non-consumable, com.padelup.retrofold.pro), which unlocks every cartridge, skin, sound pack and screen mode for good. The former "1-day Trial" item is no longer offered in the app. Restore Purchases is on the same screen.

All games are original. No account, no ads, no network access, no data collection.
